 By Cricket World & Sydney Sixers & Cricket NSW 
 Thursday 5 November 2026 
 Women's Big Bash League 
 Women T20 series Schedule 12th Match, Melbourne Live Melbourne Stars Women Sydney Sixers Women 148/4 18.5 ov SS-W elected to bat
 Sydney Sixers Women elected to bat
 Live scores and commentary 
 Sydney Sixers have retained their winning 13-player squad for their WBBL|12 match against Melbourne Stars under lights at Junction Oval.
 The Sydney Sixers will face Melbourne Stars at 7.10pm AEDT after recording consecutive victories over Brisbane Heat and Hobart Hurricanes.
 The Sixers opened their campaign with a four-wicket victory against Brisbane Heat before Ash Gardner’s century powered them to an 87-run win over Hobart Hurricanes .
 They have now selected the same squad to travel to Melbourne for the 12th match of the Women’s Big Bash League .
 WBBL squad v Melbourne Stars
 Ash Gardner (c)
 Caoimhe Bray
 Erin Burns
 Alice Capsey
 Lauren Cheatle
 Sarah Coyte
 Sophia Dunkley
 Amelia Kerr 
 Grace Lyons
 Frankie Nicklin
 Ellyse Perry 
 Eva Ragg
 Courtney Sippel
 Out – Maddy Darke (injury), Maitlan Brown (omitted), Elsa Hunter (omitted)
 Sixers prepare for Sydney derby
 Following their away fixture against Melbourne Stars, the Sydney Sixers will return home to face cross-town rivals Sydney Thunder at North Sydney Oval on Sunday from 1.40pm.
 The derby forms part of the club’s annual Summer Session Food & Beverage Festival Double Header.
